purpose: Episode 54 MiMo audio review on the Token Plan OpenAI endpoint, then a limited same-audio Anthropic comparison. The registered root calls stage.audio_review/run and provider.audio_llm/compare. Offline replay does not open a socket.
input_identity: baseline B translated and segment manifests for episode 54; stage-level, not this run's ASR chain
allowed_variable: REAL_MIMO_ONLINE=1 selects the explicit online grant; unset stays offline. REAL_CHAIN_BIND_UPSTREAM, when set, makes the same root call stage.audio_review/run_bound
order: stage.audio_review/run full episode only after that batch passes
failure_policy: HTTP 400, 401, or 403 stops that protocol; audio-unsupported is a capability result, not a text-quality failure; a text-only probe is not an audio comparison
randomness: provider text may vary; temperature is 0

online.endpoints: Token Plan OpenAI and Token Plan Anthropic only

oracle: offline attempts stay 0; online sends mimo-v2.6-pro and does not claim migration equivalence
